title: Decompose model intake decision steps + acceptance matrix for open-weight onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Provide a clear, executable decision protocol and acceptance matrix for ingesting new open-weight models into the Redwood model catalog. This ticket deconstructs the onboarding flow into discrete decision points (profiling, runtime compatibility, quality baseline, pinning recommendation, and rollback hooks) so PM, Eng, and SRE can align on required artifacts, automation, and acceptance criteria. Scope: PRD clarifications only — we will not implement all automation here. Deliverables: 1) onboarding decision checklist with required artifacts; 2) acceptance matrix mapping compatibility signals to recommended pin/policy; 3) updated intake form fields and downstream ticket seeds for automation and test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Decision checklist document that enumerates mandatory profiling artifacts: sample inputs, latency/throughput profile at 1,5,25 batch sizes, quantization test results, max sequence profiling, and memory high-water marks.

Compatibility matrix that ties concrete runtime signals (tensor shapes, KV-cache semantics, attention key ordering, supported ops, dtype/quantization modes) to a recommendation: unpinned / advisory / pinned-with-compat-guard / rejected.
A clear pinning decision rule: e.g., pin if runtime-incompatible OR perf delta > 30% for 99th-p50 latency or if degrades eval baselines by >5% on PRD test prompts.

Updated intake form spec (fields + validation rules) that includes: architecture family, expected tokenization, kv-cache semantics flag, recommended quantization, suggested test prompts, owner contact, and risk tier.

Minimum review checklist for a successful onboarding: runtime smoke tests pass, automated compat scan completes, perf delta within allowed bounds, PM sign-off and security checklist verified (if applicable).
Links to at least one example onboarding PR in GitHub and a follow-up ticket(s) assigned for automation and CI integration.
Design and UI changes required for the intake flow documented and acknowledged by Design (scope: fields/labels only).
